title: Doubles Facts to 20
objective: Retrieve doubles facts 1+1 through 10+10 quickly, after the concept (3.1.1) is secure.
studentQuestion: Can you answer without building it this time?

teaching.break: Retrieve from memory; fall back to bond-building only if stuck.
teaching.build: Answer, then move to the next.
teaching.transform: This lesson intentionally does not add a new equivalence; it drills the one already established in 3.1.1.

check.prompt: Self-check with objects for any hesitant answer.

examples.second: The same run, repeated for improvement.
examples.transfer: Doubles asked in a real-context wrapper (7 stickers, get the same number again).

mastery.evidence: Answers at least 8 of 10 doubles facts (1-10) correctly within a few seconds each.
